request.description:
Update or create a content item. * To update a content item, you need to identify the existing item by its internal ID, external ID, or codename. * To create a content item, you need to specify the [external ID](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/39ee23e8-c352-4966-b48d-7b312da3100e) as the item's identifier. You can also specify external ID when [adding content items](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/b65b450a-9c53-432b-a157-9623c951bd7a).
Content items don't contain any content themselves directly. They serve as wrappers for [language variants](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/153c924f-ed81-4236-8cfb-7937329654d8). Language variants hold the items' content even in [environments](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/c3f2cd46-66af-4191-a3dd-41c80eb2dcba) with a single language. To change the content in content items, [upsert their specific language variant](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/9de98072-589d-4076-a8bc-688c86ac0a4c).

request.description:
Change the workflow step of the specified language variant to "Published" or schedule the variant to be published at a specific date and time.

* Equivalent to [publishing](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/fc78b528-9249-4a6b-8bb3-0ab121696f2a) and [scheduling](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/807db2f1-e413-4697-9ae7-6d4f9ad32e58) content in the UI.
* The API follows the [workflow transition](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/9a4df3f8-4568-4830-be6d-f864e6509475) restrictions based on the variant's [workflow](https://kontent.ai/learn/link-to/id/d9aef4af-94c2-4376-a173-13b1c3f041ba). This means you can publish or schedule the variant (that is, move the variant to the Publish or Scheduled steps) only if the workflow allows you to.
* Scheduling a published language variant has no effect.
